narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One hundred fifty six has a pair of twos, so one hundred fifty six is a perfect square.
<bookmark mark='alone'/>Look at the three and the thirteen. Each one appears only once.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Every prime needs a partner, not only the twos.

<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Use primes to test seventy two and one hundred forty four.
